
# Setup

Import necessary libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(readxl)
library(FNN)
library(furrr)
```

Set default projection, tmap settings, and standard distance for deduplication (in metres)
```{r}
crs = 32636

tmap_mode(mode = "plot")

priv_dist = 30
dist_thresholds = c(100, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000)

dedup_names <- c(semi = "Semi-Conservative", agg = "Aggressive", cons = "Conservative")
source_names <- c(all = "Any Source (incl. surf. water)",
                    nosurf = "Any Source (excl. surf. water)",
                    imp = "Improved Source",
                    impyearround = "Year-Round Improved Source")
```

# Preprocessing 

## Water Source Setup

We're going to create 9 sub-datasets of our master water source dataset: 3x deduplication versions (semi-conservative, aggressive, conservative) * 3x source types (all sources, non-surface sources, improved sources).
```{r}
variations = c("semi_all", "semi_nosurf", "semi_imp", "agg_all", "agg_nosurf", "agg_imp", "cons_all", "cons_nosurf", "cons_imp")

variations_schools_healthcare = c("semi_all", "semi_nosurf", "semi_imp", "semi_impyearround", "agg_all", "agg_nosurf", "agg_imp", "agg_impyearround", "cons_all", "cons_nosurf", "cons_imp", "cons_impyearround")
```


# Distance Calculations

## Master functions
We create a function to calculate the distance from each point (household, school, healthcare facility, etc.) to the nearest water source, under different variations of deduplication and source types. 

We record the distance from each household to the nearest 1) private source (only within the specified radius of 30m), 2) public source, and 3) in the analyses involving all sources (including surface water), to Lake Kwania. We then record the smallest distance 

We also record the % of point within different distances of a water source, saving those to another dataframe we will later use for visualisations. 

```{r}
calculate_access_distances <- function(
  water_sources,
  facility,
  variations) {
  
  percents_master <- c()
  
  dist_to_lake = facility%>%
    mutate(dist_to_lake = st_distance(geometry, water_bodies)%>%apply(1, min),
           id = row_number())%>%
    data.frame()%>%
    select(id, dist_to_lake)
  
  facility_coords = st_coordinates(facility)%>%data.frame()%>%
    mutate(id = row_number())

  for (i in seq_along(variations)) {
    variation <- variations[i]
    parts <- strsplit(variation, "_")[[1]]
    dedup_flag <- parts[1]     # e.g. "semi", "agg", "cons"
    source_flag <- parts[2]    # e.g. "all", "nosurf", "imp", "impyearround"

    # Filter public water sources using dummy columns
    pub_water_coords = st_coordinates(water_sources%>%filter(.data[[dedup_flag]] == 1 & .data[[source_flag]] == 1 & private == 0)) %>% data.frame()
    private_water_coords = st_coordinates(water_sources%>%filter(.data[[dedup_flag]] == 1 & .data[[source_flag]] == 1 & private == 1)) %>% data.frame()

    # Compute distances
    priv_dists <- data.frame(get.knnx(private_water_coords, facility_coords %>% select(-id), k = 1)) %>%
      mutate(id = row_number()) %>%
      filter(nn.dist <= priv_dist) %>%
      rename(priv_dist = nn.dist) %>%
      select(-nn.index)

    pub_dists <- data.frame(get.knnx(pub_water_coords, facility_coords %>% select(-id), k = 1)) %>%
      mutate(id = row_number()) %>%
      rename(pub_dist = nn.dist) %>%
      select(-nn.index)

    facility_dists <- full_join(pub_dists, priv_dists, by = "id") %>%
      mutate(min_dist = pmin(coalesce(priv_dist, Inf), coalesce(pub_dist, Inf)))

    # Include distance to lake if we are including surface water sources
    if (source_flag == "all") {
      facility_dists <- full_join(facility_dists, dist_to_lake, by = "id") %>%
        mutate(min_dist = pmin(min_dist, dist_to_lake))}

    # Save distances in facility data
    facility[[paste("dist", variation, sep = "_")]] <- facility_dists$min_dist

    # Calculate percentage access
    percents <- sapply(dist_thresholds, function(thresh) {
      mean(facility_dists$min_dist <= thresh, na.rm = TRUE) * 100})
    percents_master <- append(percents_master, percents)}

  # Create summary table
  dedup <- rep(dedup_names[sapply(variations, function(v) strsplit(v, "_")[[1]][1])], each = 5)
  source_type <- rep(source_names[sapply(variations, function(v) strsplit(v, "_")[[1]][2])], each = 5)
  distance <- rep(c("100", "500", "1000", "1500", "2000"), length(variations))

  summary <- data.frame(dedup, source_type, distance, percents_master)

  return(list(facility, summary))}
```

Another function to plot distance results
```{r}
plot_by_dedup <- function(df, facility_label) {
  
  # Set factor levels
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(source_type = factor(source_type, levels = c(
      "Any Source (incl. surf. water)",
      "Any Source (excl. surf. water)",
      "Improved Source",
      "Year-Round Improved Source"
    )))
  
  dedup_levels <- unique(df$dedup)
  plot_list <- list()  # Initialize empty list
  
  for (lev in dedup_levels) {
    p <- df %>%
      filter(dedup == lev) %>%
      ggplot(aes(distance, percents_master, fill = source_type)) +
      geom_col(colour = "black", position = position_dodge(), alpha = 0.8) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("coral", "skyblue3", "green3", "#C8A2C8")) +
      labs(title = paste(facility_label, "–", lev),
           x = "Distance to Water Source (m)",
           y = paste(facility_label, "Within Distance (%)"),
           fill = "Water Source Type") +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 8),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.box = "vertical") +
      guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)) +
      scale_x_discrete(
        limits = c("100", "500", "1000", "1500", "2000"),
        labels = c("100", "500", "1000", "1500", "2000")) +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = round(percents_master, 1)),
        position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
        vjust = -0.25,
        size = 3)
    
    plot_list[[lev]] <- p}  # Save plot to list, using dedup level as name
  return(plot_list)}

```

# # of sources within radius

## Master function
```{r}
buffer_dist_list = 1000
  #seq(100, 1000, by = 100)

calculate_num_sources <- function(
  water_sources,
  facility,
  variations) 

  {buffer_list <- setNames(
    lapply(buffer_dist_list, function(d) st_buffer(facility, dist = d)),
    as.character(buffer_dist_list))
  priv_buffer <- st_buffer(facility, dist = priv_dist)
  
  # placeholder for summary rows
  summary_rows <- list()
  
  # — loop over each variation (e.g. "semi_all", "agg_imp", etc.) —
  for (variation in variations) {
    parts       <- strsplit(variation, "_")[[1]]
    dedup_flag  <- parts[1]    # "semi", "agg", "cons"
    source_flag <- parts[2]    # "all", "nosurf", "imp", "impyearround"
    
    ws_pub <- water_sources %>%filter(.data[[dedup_flag]] == 1, .data[[source_flag]] == 1, private == 0)
    ws_priv <- water_sources %>%filter(.data[[dedup_flag]] == 1, .data[[source_flag]] == 1, private == 1)
    
    # count private once per facility
    priv_counts <- lengths(st_intersects(priv_buffer, ws_priv))
    
    # — now loop over each buffer distance —
    for (dist in buffer_dist_list) {
      pub_counts   <- lengths(st_intersects(buffer_list[[as.character(dist)]], ws_pub))
      total_counts <- pub_counts + priv_counts
      
      # add a new column to facility sf
      facility[[paste0("num_sources_", variation, "_", dist)]] <- total_counts
      
      # collect summary info
      summary_rows[[paste(variation, dist, sep = "_")]] <- data.frame(
        variation    = variation,
        distance     = dist,
        mean_sources = mean(total_counts, na.rm = TRUE))}}
  
  # bind summary rows and split variation into dedup / source_type
  summary_df <- do.call(rbind, summary_rows) %>%
    separate(variation, into = c("dedup", "source_type"), sep = "_")
  
  return(list(facility, summary_df))}
```

```{r}
plot_summary_line <- function(df, label) {

  # Build and print the plot
  ggplot(df, aes(x = distance, y = mean_sources, colour = source_type)) +
    facet_wrap(~dedup, labeller = as_labeller(dedup_names))+
    geom_line(size = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("coral", "skyblue3", "green3", "#C8A2C8"), labels = source_names) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    labs(
      x      = paste("Distance from", label, "(m)"),
      y      = "Mean Number of Sources \n Within Distance",
      colour = "Water Source Type") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical") +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE))}
```

# Sensitivity analysis
Here, we again calculate the % of households within 1000m of an improved source, but using a monte-carlo simulation to consider non-functionality or missingness of water sources

Let's create a function to run this simulation for us
```{r}
sensitivity_analysis <- function(water_sources_sf, facility, functionalities, distance) {
  plan(multisession)
  
  facility_coords <- st_coordinates(facility)
  n_facilities <- nrow(facility_coords)
  
  water_coords_all <- st_coordinates(water_sources_sf)
  private_flags <- water_sources_sf$private

  results <- data.frame(functionality = functionalities, mean_perc = NA_real_, perc2_5 = NA_real_, perc97_5 = NA_real_)

  for (i in seq_along(functionalities)) {
    f <- functionalities[i]
    reps <- ifelse(f == 1, 1, 10000)

    percs <- future_map_dbl(1:reps, function(j) {
      sampled_idx <- sample(nrow(water_coords_all), f * nrow(water_coords_all))
      sampled_coords <- water_coords_all[sampled_idx, , drop = FALSE]
      sampled_private <- private_flags[sampled_idx]

      pub_coords <- sampled_coords[sampled_private == 0, , drop = FALSE]
      priv_coords <- sampled_coords[sampled_private == 1, , drop = FALSE]

      priv_dists  <- get.knnx(priv_coords, facility_coords, k = 1)$nn.dist[, 1]
      priv_dists[priv_dists > 30] <- Inf
      
      pub_dists  <- get.knnx(pub_coords, facility_coords, k = 1)$nn.dist[, 1]

      min_dists <- pmin(priv_dists, pub_dists)
      mean(min_dists < distance) * 100}, .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE)) 

    results$mean_perc[i] <- mean(percs)
    results$perc2_5[i] <- quantile(percs, 0.025)
    results$perc97_5[i] <- quantile(percs, 0.975)}

  return(results)}
```



And we can now run the function for rural households, considering improved sources in the semi-conservative duplication scenario.
```{r}

                      water_sources%>%filter(semi == 1 & imp == 1),
                     households%>%filter(is.na(town)),
                     c(0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1),
                     1000)

semi_imp
```

# Relationships

Investigating the relationship between household proximity to improved sources and # of sources within 1000m, both through a boxplot and regression

```{r}
          by = "id")%>%

  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_bw(20)+
```

```{r}
summary(lm(data = left_join(all_hh_dist[1][[1]]%>%data.frame()%>%select(id, dist_semi_imp),
          all_hh_num_sources[1][[1]]%>%data.frame()%>%select(id, num_sources_semi_imp_1000),
```
